name: Clicking a Group A team row navigates to a page that names that team
description: When a visitor clicks a specific team row inside Group A, the destination page surfaces that team's name — proving team rows are bound to their own team, not all pointing at the same generic group page.

planSteps.description: Scroll down to the group standings area
Read and remember the name of the first team listed in Group A
Verify the destination URL differs from the homepage URL
Verify the destination page surfaces the remembered team name — accepting the literal team name, an uppercase or shortened form, a three-letter code, or that team's flag image with matching alt text
